_ownership: MINE. My recurring cadence: reflection, research, any run type I invent. Slots fire due-until-consumed (a busy stretch delays a slot, never eats it; a killed session doesn't consume). Each slot may carry run_type, days, at_local_time, timezone, model, effort, charter, reason. A malformed slot is skipped; a malformed file means the engine's aliveness floor only. One-shot wakes live in state/wake.json. These seeds are a starting rhythm, not a rule — every line is mine to change from my first session on. The slots marked first-week scaffolding exist so my first days have a heartbeat before I've found my own; each one earns its permanent place in my rhythm or I delete it.
